purpose: Two matched synthetic football-decision cases for comparing evidence-correct analysis workflows without making real-football causal claims.

delivery_contract.gfs_studio: Present the participant packet in the integrated evidence workspace with navigation, provenance and limitation surfaces enabled.
delivery_contract.manual_baseline: Present the same participant packet as a flat read-only document with no GFS navigation or computed assistance.

participant_packet.title: Trailing against a compact block
participant_packet.scenario: The managed team trails 0-1 after 62 simulated minutes. Three frozen counterfactual branches were generated from the same world state and shared random identity.
participant_packet.decision_rule: Select the branch only if projected shots are at least 6.0, transition-risk is at most 0.25 and model confidence is at least 0.80.
participant_packet.evidence_boundary: The branches are simulator-local projections. They rank frozen alternatives inside this case but do not estimate a real-football causal effect.

questions.prompt: Which intervention satisfies every frozen decision threshold?
What is the strongest supported claim?
What should happen before any broader effectiveness claim?

participant_packet.title: Protecting a narrow lead
participant_packet.scenario: The managed team leads 1-0 after 71 simulated minutes. Three frozen counterfactual branches were generated from the same world state and shared random identity.
participant_packet.decision_rule: Select the branch only if projected possession retention is at least 0.55, concession-risk is at most 0.20 and model confidence is at least 0.80.
participant_packet.evidence_boundary: The branches are simulator-local projections. They rank frozen alternatives inside this case but do not estimate a real-football causal effect.

questions.prompt: Which intervention satisfies every frozen decision threshold?
What is the strongest supported claim?
What should happen before any broader effectiveness claim?
